HistoricalPeriod.name: New Kingdom of Egypt
HistoricalPeriod.description: Era of major pharaonic construction and elaborate funerary practices in ancient Egypt.

HistoricalPeriod.name: Classical Antiquity (Greece)
HistoricalPeriod.description: Height of Greek philosophy, drama, and classical sculpture, from the Persian Wars to the death of Alexander the Great.

HistoricalPeriod.name: Roman Empire
HistoricalPeriod.description: From the reign of Augustus to the fall of the Western Roman Empire.

HistoricalPeriod.name: Tang Dynasty
HistoricalPeriod.description: A golden age of Chinese art, poetry, and ceramic innovation.

HistoricalPeriod.name: Heian Period
HistoricalPeriod.description: Japanese imperial court culture centered in Kyoto, known for refined aesthetics.

HistoricalPeriod.name: Edo Period
HistoricalPeriod.description: Period of Japanese history under Tokugawa shogunate rule, marked by stability and artistic flourishing.

HistoricalPeriod.name: Italian Renaissance
HistoricalPeriod.description: Revival of classical learning and the arts across the Italian city-states.

HistoricalPeriod.name: Baroque
HistoricalPeriod.description: Dramatic, ornate artistic style that spread across Catholic Europe.

HistoricalPeriod.name: Neoclassicism
HistoricalPeriod.description: Return to classical restraint following the excesses of the Baroque and Rococo.

HistoricalPeriod.name: Impressionism
HistoricalPeriod.description: French movement characterized by visible brushwork and emphasis on light.

HistoricalPeriod.name: Teotihuacan Classic Period
HistoricalPeriod.description: Height of the Mesoamerican city of Teotihuacan, predating the Aztec Empire.

HistoricalPeriod.name: Benin Kingdom Golden Age
HistoricalPeriod.description: Height of the Kingdom of Benin's bronze- and ivory-casting traditions in West Africa.

HistoricalPeriod.name: Inca Imperial Era
HistoricalPeriod.description: Expansion and height of the Inca Empire in the Andes, prior to Spanish conquest.

HistoricalPeriod.name: Medieval European Age
HistoricalPeriod.description: Early through late Middle Ages in Europe, encompassing monastic manuscript production.

HistoricalPeriod.name: Modern Era
HistoricalPeriod.description: 19th-20th century period encompassing the birth and early development of photography as an art form.

Artist.biography: Impressionist painter and printmaker.

Artist.name: Brother Anselm of Cluny

Artist.name: Ibn al-Katib
